content: Anthropic's 'writing tools for agents' guide: few workflow-oriented tools beat many narrow endpoint wrappers; consolidating chained operations (e.g. book-and-confirm in one call) reduces context churn; descriptions are the highest-leverage artifact and should onboarding-style document when to use the tool, units, and terminology; parameter names must be unambiguous; return high-signal data (names not uuids); error messages must state specific actionable fixes. Idempotency is not covered by the guide; general API practice is idempotency keys or upsert semantics for retry-safe writes.
